section2_conclusion: URDF->SDF joint-origin conversion is arithmetically correct to 1e-9 m: gz sdf -p collapsed panda_hand into panda_link7 and recomputed each finger joint origin as hand_xyz + Rz(hand_yaw) @ urdf_origin. Axis, limits, effort, velocity, damping, friction, mass and inertia also match the URDF exactly. Candidates 1 and 2 are falsified as conversion errors.

section6_minimal_model.status: RAN — the minimal model tracks, so Gazebo prismatic semantics are sound
section6_minimal_model.verdict: Minimal model works. Per section 6 that puts the fault in the Panda finger conversion/configuration, not in Gazebo prismatic joints.

what_each_variant_rules_out.base: A plain prismatic joint with the finger mass, inertia, pad box, limits, damping and friction tracks the full 0..40 mm stroke with 0.000 m error. Gazebo prismatic joints are sound in isolation (candidates 5,6,7,8,9,10,14 not implicated by those values).
what_each_variant_rules_out.parentcoll: Giving the parent panda_link7's real cylinder collision (r 0.045, l 0.1) changes nothing: still 0.000 m error. Falsifies 11 and 12.
what_each_variant_rules_out.pandalink: Giving the joint the Panda's exact link7-relative pose AND the child link the Panda's exact absolute pose (180 deg roll, flipped y) changes nothing: still 0.000 m error. Falsifies 3 as a stall cause, even though removing those poses in the real Panda shifts the stall 5.2 -> 8.1 mm.
what_each_variant_rules_out.pandagains: Replicating the finger gains exactly (p 1000, i 100, d 50, i_max +/-4, cmd_max 100) produces a 3.6 mm steady-state lag that shrinks monotonically (3.62 mm at cmd 0.005 down to 1.56 mm at cmd 0.040) and still reaches the full stroke. This is a SLOW integral, not a hard stall, because the finger here is loaded only by its own 0.147 N of gravity while the Panda finger carries about 5 N. Does NOT reproduce the Panda stall, so 15 is not supported by it.

section6_minimal_model.note_on_integral: p_gain/i_gain = 1000/100 means the finger integral needs ~10 s of sustained error to cancel a proportional term. Against the Panda finger's ~5 N reaction that is far longer than any episode, which is why the Panda jaw creeps instead of closing.
